blockingIssues.problem: Claims the committee continued the trial “because the germination results convinced it that the dry cupboard was promising,” attributing a causal belief and level of confidence that the source does not state.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: “At its March meeting, the committee chose to keep the same two lots in the cupboard for another six months and repeat the germination check.” AND “The notes give no claim that the cupboard caused an improvement and no promise of better garden results.” (Also: “No paired comparison of the same lot in both places was run,” and “Temperature was logged only in the new cupboard.”)
blockingIssues.constraint: Do not state or imply that the committee believed the dry cupboard caused improvement or that it was ‘promising’; the source does not attribute that reason.

blockingIssues.problem: Reframes the donor update from an explanatory account of observations and a limited continuation into a positive endorsement that the cupboard is promising, changing the intended communication task.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: “The community seed bank needs a donor update explaining its decision on a small storage trial. ... The donor update should explain what was observed and why the decision remains a limited continuation.” AND “The notes give no claim that the cupboard caused an improvement and no promise of better garden results.”
blockingIssues.constraint: The source assigns the task of explaining observations and why the decision remains a limited continuation; it does not direct producing an endorsement or asserting causality.
